text: Date and time first. “Contemporaneous” is Latin for “not tonight.”
The journal is your witness. Feed it every act and it will testify for you.
Log the refusal. A documented no has protected more notaries than any yes.
Fill the entry at the table, not in the car. The car is where memory edits.
Ink beats memory, and both beat a confident recollection under oath.
Your commission expiry lives on a calendar, not in your confidence.
You witness identity and willingness. You do not explain what a document means.
A stamp is not a practice.
Your price is not a number you picked. It is the fee your state set, plus the cost of an hour of your life.
Ninety days is not how long it takes to be good. It is how long it takes to stop guessing at your price.
A neighbor’s number in the binder is worth three in a phone nobody can unlock.
Every water shutoff is easy to find twice: once on a calm Tuesday, once during a flood. Choose the Tuesday.
Houses do not break suddenly. They break unattended.
Write it in the order the day happens, not the order of importance. A stranger at 6:45 needs to know what 7:00 looks like.
Memory is not a filing system.
A death does not create a deadline. Take the day.
“Somewhere in the office” costs your executor a weekend per document.
Done in the wrong order beats perfect in no order.
A broker who runs the four motions on schedule is a practice. A broker who runs them by memory is a person with a caseload.
Families do not need a broker who knows everything. They need one whose practice is in good order.
A covering broker opens any family and knows in ninety seconds where things stand. That is the standard.
If the business stops when you stop, the business is you.
Written means findable by a stranger. Not stored in your memory, not in a folder only you can navigate.
Overdue is not a feeling. It is a count of days, per client, sorted worst first.
The commission gave you permission. Not a business.
A notary journal written for Maryland.
It is not a will. It is a map.
Could a stranger run this house for two weeks?
For the broker who carries everyone.
Set up, run, bill, and grow a practice inside self-direction.
